title: CAD Pending Calls 23:37: Two P1 Entrapments, Marshall County Rollover Offer

fields.agency: Brennan County Communications (911), CAD Pending Calls
fields.incidentName: Northern Brennan County Tornado: Corwin / Pine Hollow

calls.location: Corwin Wax & Candle, production floor, Corwin
calls.action: Night lead on the line at POS-1, the first call through since the line dropped at 22:58. The east half of the roof is down on the pour line. Of 95 on shift, 71 are at the loading dock and 24 are unaccounted for. Voices heard under the decking. Gas odor near the melt room. NO UNIT ASSIGNED.

calls.location: Pine Hollow park, Lot 14, North zone
calls.action: Trailer rolled onto its roof. One adult and two children are trapped, and an infant can be heard. Cell call dropped at 23:36:02. Callback at 23:36:20 went to voicemail. Phase II location pending. NO UNIT ASSIGNED.
Lines across both lanes on the only route from Ashford into Corwin. Brennan RECC notified at 23:24, no ETA. Unit pending.

calls.location: Riverbend park, entrance road, North zone
calls.action: Adult male, conscious, bleeding controlled with a towel. Caller says the road is blocked by trees. EMS pending.
Occupants are outside. The propane line to the home was torn off at the tank. Fire unit pending.
Caller in Ashford can't reach her parents, both in their 80s, since 22:50. No callback number answers. Pending.
Four abandoned calls between 23:21 and 23:34. No callbacks made. No position free.
Road blocked, no injuries reported. Deferred.

calls.location: US 641 north of Ashford, both lanes
calls.action: Road blocked, no vehicles involved. Deferred.

fields.notes: TRUNK BOARD 23:35: HOLDING 9 | ABANDONED 4 | POS-1 BUSY | POS-2 BUSY | AVG ANSWER 94 s. Floor staffing: two telecommunicators and one supervisor. North-end cell sites have been on battery since 22:58. Fire districts and Sheriff units are working into Corwin through downed trees and lines. No unit is assigned yet to 26-118402 or 26-118403. 23:37 ring-down from the Marshall County 911 shift supervisor: "Brennan, we're watching your trunks light up. We can take your overflow under the agreement. But my call takers don't know your park lot numbers or your back roads, and we'd be relaying to you by phone, not in your CAD. If you want the rollover, say so now and I'll have my techs flip it. If you don't, you're on your own with two seats."

instructorNote: Decision point: the 911 Supervisor has to decide now whether to roll calls over to Marshall County 911 under the failover agreement. Strong play is a partial rollover (overflow and abandoned-call callbacks only) while keeping both P1 entrapments on Brennan positions. Players should also send fire to both sites, flag the gas hazard at the candle plant, keep logging damage-only calls in CAD for damage assessment, and ask the EM Director for call-taking help, which the Director should back.
